company.shortDescription: Slices is a homegrown food & beverage company & mission to transform eating habits.
company.description: Slices is a homegrown UAE food and beverage company dedicated to transforming eating habits through healthy and nutritious catering solutions. The company primarily serves schools by offering balanced meals, healthy snacks, parent cafés, and hospitality services designed to support student wellbeing and healthier lifestyles. Slices operates with a strong focus on food quality, nutrition education, and sustainable eating practices, delivering freshly prepared meals from its central kitchen facilities across the UAE.
